header: Out of 65,476 cases reported during the year in the seven Union Territories, 59,871 (91.4%) were reported in the National Capital Territory of Delhi alone. This constituted 3.5 per cent of the total (17,09,576) crimes reported at the national level. Next in order were the UTs of Pondicherry (2,469) and Chandigarh (2,048). The remaining 4 UTs reported less than 500 cases apiece during the year.

Though, all the Union Territories except Delhi, recorded less than 2,500 IPC crimes during the year 1996, four of these occupied the higher slots, as far as the crime rate is concerned. Delhi, which reported 59,871 such crimes during the year, recorded the highest crime rate (527.0) in the country. The next in order were Pondicherry (274.3), Dadra & Nagar Haveli (256.3) and Chandigarh (252.8). The above four UTs were therefore, ranked as the Ist, 2nd, 3rd and 4th respectively in the ranking of crime rate among the UTs. Rate
